fact: The SNIAM 2023-2027 states it was adopted by the Council of Ministers on 18 January 2023, and sets overall steering and coordination of implementation with the Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation, with ASIN contributing to AI projects; funding need estimated at about 4.68 billion FCFA.
title: Stratégie Nationale d'Intelligence Artificielle et des Mégadonnées 2023-2027
publisher: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation du Bénin
